dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible irregularly shaped 'C' and 'O' rings distributed across the mid-dorsal and lateral flanks; most prominent is a closed elliptical 'O' structure on the upper-mid lateral section with a sharp gradient from a light grey interior to a dark perimeter, alongside several jagged 'C' shapes near the cervical-dorsal transition.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High concentration of small, solid light-colored pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily clustered in the lower cervical region and scattered across the ventral-lateral boundary of the mid-body.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest macro-annuli on the mid-lateral flank form an obtuse scalene triangle, with the longest side oriented parallel to the dorsal ridge and the most acute angle directed towards the posterior region.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced texture gradient transition from high-frequency, high-contrast speckling on the anterior neck to a near-uniform dark, low-intensity region on the posterior fluke and tail area.
